findings.description: sweep() calls transfer() without checking its returned bool. A token that signals failure by returning false (instead of reverting) lets the call silently no-op while the caller believes the transfer succeeded.
evidence: function sweep(address token, address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
findings.recommendation: Check the return value, e.g. require(IERC20(token).transfer(to, amount), "transfer failed").

limitations: Off-chain logic, deployment configuration and key management were not assessed.
Operational security, infrastructure and tokenomics outside the analyzed code were not assessed.
Deployed contract state and third-party systems were not assessed.
